name: Zhuizong Zhe
source:
My name is Li Muyu, born in 1998 into an ordinary family. From childhood to adulthood, my life has been uneventful. Nothing good ever seemed to come my way, let alone anything earth-shattering. But then, on the 7,665th day of my life—a day that would turn out to be anything but ordinary—something "good" finally happened to me......

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1016750/TRACKER/]steam[/url]]
